nodes.label: Tiered delivery pricing by haversine distance band
delivery_max_distance_km hard cap — address is simply not deliverable
Rationale: bands stored canonically in KILOMETRES to match pickup_area_radius_km
Rationale: kept dependency-free so booking and portal can each hold their own copy
Address-autocomplete radius filter — only surface addresses the operator will deliver to
Unknown distance resolves to the cheapest band so the UI can show a "from $X" badge
Low e-sign credit alerting for tenants
Depleted credits park rental agreements as document_status='credit_failed' and the customer never gets the contract
Rationale: helper never throws so it can be awaited inline in the esign route without risking the agreement flow
Reminder dedupe + warning→critical escalation only (no re-alert per deduction)
Reuses the same reminders / reminder_config infrastructure as the Bonzah low-balance monitor
Test mode never spends live credits, so alerting is skipped entirely
Tenant currency formatting (USD/GBP/EUR locale map)
Per-tenant miles/km distance unit system and label vocabulary
Rationale: km is the DB storage unit for radii; display unit conversion happens only at the edge
Google Places session-token batching (autocomplete + fetchFields as one billed session)
Rationale: session pricing (~$2.83/1000 sessions) is far cheaper than per-request Places billing
Customer invoice creation with line-item breakdown (rental, protection, tax, deposit, insurance, delivery, extras)
Rationale: local in-memory invoice fallback so a failed DB insert never blocks the booking
Gotcha: discount_amount and promo_code are deliberately excluded from the DB insert — the columns do not exist on invoices; total_amount already nets the discount
Invoice number scheme INV-YYYYMMDD-XXXX (timestamp + random, no DB sequence)
Server-side loader for /privacy and /terms legal pages
Rationale: client-rendered legal pages served blank HTML to A2P 10DLC carrier crawlers, causing SMS campaign rejections 30908 and 30882
SMS disclosure safety net injected into privacy policy when a tenant's own copy omits it (Twilio's canonical no-share sentence)
Terms SMS compliance clause (carrier-liability disclaimer, STOP/HELP, inline privacy link) appended when missing
Content fallback chain: tenant-published CMS page → global page (tenant_id IS NULL) → in-app default
Rationale: fetch errors are swallowed so a network failure can never blank a compliance page
Tenant identity (name, contact email/phone, Twilio number) for server-rendered legal page chrome
Client-side CMS page content hook whose fetch strategy the server loader mirrors
Pro-rata mileage allowance per rental tier (daily/weekly/monthly)
Mileage tier boundaries deliberately mirror the pricing tier logic (7 days weekly, monthlyTierDays monthly)
Unlimited-mileage upsell — flat price keyed to the booking's tier, suppressed for inherently unlimited vehicles
Rewrites Supabase Storage public object URLs to the on-the-fly image transform endpoint (resize/quality/WebP)
PAYG daily-rate derivation from rentals.monthly_amount + rental_period_type
Rationale: must stay in lockstep with accrue-payg-charges/computeDailyRate and apps/portal/src/lib/payg-rate.ts — divergence means the customer sees a different daily charge than they are billed
DOMPurify allowlist sanitization for rich-text/blog HTML rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Gotcha: sanitizeHtml returns the raw string unchanged when window is undefined — it is a no-op during server rendering
Dependency-free input sanitization for customer form fields (name, email, phone, address, free text)
Heuristic injection-pattern detector (script/javascript:/on*=/iframe/svg)
Tenant-scoped read helpers for the customer booking site (vehicles, settings, blocked dates, promotions, testimonials)
Pre-booking eligibility gate: global blacklist → customer is_blocked → blocked email identity → blocked licence identity
Login-time blocking check re-running the same three checks as the booking gate
Cross-tenant global blacklist (email blocked by 3+ tenants), overridable by is_whitelisted
Booking creation that stamps tenant_id onto the rentals insert
Gotcha: getTenantVehicles / getTenantVehicleById still SELECT * on vehicles — the exact pattern the vehicle column allowlist exists to replace
Per-tenant customer-site theme mode (dark/light/light_only/dark_only)
Rationale: next-themes 0.3.0 does not fold forcedTheme into resolvedTheme, so a returning customer's stored 'dark' would paint the dark palette onto a forced-light page
USA + UK IANA timezone catalog with browser detection and offset labels
US state code/label catalog for address and licence forms
Tailwind class merge helper (shadcn convention, duplicated per app)
Turn-by-turn deep links to Google Maps / Waze / Apple Maps for a delivery or pickup address
Single source of truth for "is this vehicle occupied for the requested dates?"
Rationale: pure date-overlap availability showed physically-out cars as AVAILABLE when end_date went stale (auto-extension that never rolled the date, paused auto-extend, unclosed overdue rental)
Rental statuses that still hold a vehicle vs statuses meaning the car is physically out right now
NULL end_date means an open-ended / PAYG rental and always overlaps
Customer-facing vehicle column allowlist — new columns are private by default

Rationale: RLS filters rows but never columns, so select('*') with an anon table grant shipped lockbox_code, lockbox_instructions, purchase_price, security_notes and owner_id to every browser holding the public anon key
May we reveal the number plate right now? — resolves tenant preference plus tenant-load state
Rationale: a null TenantContext must withhold the plate — collapsing "not opted in" with "not yet known" fails OPEN on a privacy control, permanently for a useEffect([]) that never re-runs
hide_vehicle_registration is a display preference, not a storage change — vehicles.reg is NOT NULL and globally unique so it is only ever withheld
Customer-safe vehicle name whose fallback chain never terminates at the plate
Rationale: screens used the plate as the make/model fallback, so suppressing it turned vehicle headings into empty strings; the plate had leaked into ~77 places for want of a shared name helper
Plate search must be disabled too — a searchable hidden field is not hidden
Per-photo plate redaction serving — customers get redacted_url only for photos the operator marked
Rationale: photo redaction is deliberately NOT deny-by-default — redaction_status 'none' means "not reviewed yet", and blanking a whole gallery on a text toggle would be the worse surprise
VIN is never in the public column list — it is the identity key INSHUR binds cover against
Booking-site tenant resolution: subdomain fast path, then custom_booking_domain lookup, injected as x-tenant-slug
Reserved subdomains (www, admin, portal, api, app, bonzah) have their own Vercel projects and are never tenant slugs
Per-tenant favicon served at /favicon.ico and /favicon.png via 307 redirect
Rationale: browsers and Google fetch /favicon.ico directly instead of honoring <link rel=icon>, so every tenant otherwise showed Drive 247's icon
Middleware runs Supabase with the public anon key on every uncached request to resolve tenant + favicon
Vestigial pages-router _app.tsx — a bare pass-through; the real provider chain lives in the App Router layout
